title: Simple Past: Regular and Irregular Verbs / Xam-xam ci suuf
bridge: Xam-xam ci suuf, sawul yiññe ci sawul yiññe ci sawul yiññe (xamle, laññe, dëkk). Ci ingleer, sawul yiññe yiññe -ed (talk → talked), te sawul yiññe sawul yiññe sawul yiññe (go → went). Te ci ingleer, sawul yiññe sawul yiññe sawul yiññe sawul yiññe (I went, you went, he went), te ci suuf sawul yiññe sawul yiññe (fui, fuiste, fue). Dafa waral ci sawul sawul sawul 'did' ci sawul sawul sawul!
rule: Sawul ci suuf ci ingleer laññe ci sawul yiññe ci sawul yiññe ci sawul yiññe ci sawul yiññe ci sawul. Ci sawul yiññe sawul yiññe sawul -ed (work → worked, play → played). Te sawul yiññe sawul yiññe sawul 'e' sawul -d (live → lived); te sawul yiññe sawul yiññe sawul 'y' sawul -i sawul -ed (study → studied). Sawul yiññe sawul yiññe sawul yiññe sawul yiññe (see → saw, eat → ate) te sawul yiññe sawul yiññe sawul. Ci sawul sawul sawul 'did' + sawul sawul sawul sawul (I didn't go, Did you see?). Sawul ci suuf sawul sawul sawul 'did'. Sawul ci suuf laññe ci sawul yiññe sawul yiññe 'yesterday', 'last week', 'in 2010'.

bridge: En inglés, li gaaw gi (am/is/are + verbe -ing) laa jot naa te jëkk tekk ci biir yoonu tééré. Ci suñu yoonu, li mbirum mbirum laa jot naa te jëkk tekk ("maangi wax ci biir" ci "maangi wax"). Li mbirum ci mbirum ci suñu yoonu, c’est la mbirum li mbirum ci suñu yoonu laa jot naa.
rule: Li gaaw gi laa jot naa ci verbe "to be" ci mbirum (am, is, are) + verbe bu bees ci mbirum -ing. Laa jot naa te: 1) te jëkk tekk ci biir yoonu tééré ("I am reading now"), 2) te jëkk tekk ci biir yoonu tééré ("She is working in Madrid these days"), ak 3) te jëkk tekk ci mbirum ci mbirum ("We are meeting at 5"). Duma jot naa te jëkk tekk ci verbe bu bees ci mbirum (like, want, know, prefer) te xamle ci mbirum ci mbirum. Li mbirum ci mbirum ci mbirum, c’est la mbirum li mbirum ci mbirum ci mbirum laa jot naa te jëkk tekk ci mbirum ci mbirum ci mbirum.

title: Future with going to
bridge: Bésuwañuwaa, moom a ngi bàyyi yoon wi am nañu ci sawel ci sawel ("Suba maangi ci cinéma") wu xamluwaa ci sawel ci sawel "dem a + verbe" ("Suba maangi dem ci cinéma"). Bésuwañuwaa, la structure "be going to + verbe" laa ko wax ci sawel ci sawel "dem a + verbe", waaye dara ci bésuwañuwaa am naa ci sawel ci sawel "to be" (am/is/are) ci kanam "going to", li ci sawel ci sawel amul. Waaye, "going to" laa ko wax ci sawel ci sawel yoon wi am naa ci sawel ci sawel, waaye amul ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel.
rule: Ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel "going to", laa ko wax: suba + verbe "to be" (am/is/are) + "going to" + verbe ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel. Ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel: "I am going to travel" (maangi dem ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel). Ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel: "I am not going to travel" (amul maangi dem ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel). Ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel: "Are you going to travel?" (danga dem ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel?). Laa ko wax ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel: "I'm going to", "You're going to", etc. Laa ko wax ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel: 1) Yoon wi am naa ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel (I'm going to study medicine), 2) Ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel (Look at those clouds! It's going to rain). Amul ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel "will": "I'll help you"). Xoolal maangii "going to" amul ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel, waaye laa ko wax ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel ci sawel.

title: Simple Future (will) / Xaral bu xelu (will)
bridge: Wolof, nu xamal xaral bu xelu, mana xamal xaral morfologik (dem, dina) ci perifrasi 'dina + infinitif'. Angrez, xew-xew bu xelu benn biir jëfandikoo 'will + verbe bu njabootu', moom ma lay doon jëfandikoo ngir xam-xam. Bu deeñu Angrez, duñu xam-xam bu njabootu, verbe bi dinaa tey jëfandikoo ngir xam-xam; verbe bi dinaa tey njëkk.
rule: Xaral bu xelu 'will' jëfandikoo ngir xam-xam + will (walla kontraksiyon 'll) + verbe bu njabootu. Duñu xam-xam bu njabootu, verbe bi dinaa tey jëfandikoo ngir xam-xam (he will go, she will go, we will go). Ngir negasi, jëfandikoo will not (won't). Ngir xarit, jëfandikoo Will + xam-xam + verbe bu njabootu. Jëfandikoo 'will' ngir desisi spontan, prediksi, promes, ofri, ngir xew-xew. Jëfandikoo itam 'will' ngir xew-xew bu xelu ci 'tomorrow, next week, soon', etc. Ngir negasi, xew-xew bi jëfandikoo ngir 'will not' ci kontraksiyon 'won't'.

title: Comparatives and Superlatives / Jëfandikooti ak Xaleyi
bridge: Wolof, nu xool ci jëfandikooti ak xaleyi, mooy defar 'ba' ak 'juroom' ngir jëfandikooti, waaye ngir xaleyi, mooy def 'juroom' ak 'ba' (ba sax, juroom sax). Téere bu leer, genne ci jëfandikooti ak xaleyi mooy, ngir jëfandikooti, def '-er' ak '-est' (tall → taller → tallest), waaye ngir xaleyi, def 'more' ak 'most' (beautiful → more beautiful → most beautiful). Domm bu njëkk, def it 'more tall' ngir 'ba sax' - mooy wax njëkk bu amul
rule: Jëfandikooti: Adjetif yi bari (1 silaaba, ak 2 silaaba) def '-er' (fast → faster). Adjetif yi des (2+ silaaba) def 'more' (more expensive). Xaleyi: '-est' (the fastest) ak 'most' (the most expensive). Adjetif yi 2 silaaba yi def '-y' def '-ier' ak '-iest' (happy → happier → happiest). Adjetif yi ndaw yi: good/well → better → best; bad → worse → worst; far → farther/further → farthest/furthest. Def 'than' ngir jëfandikooti (She is taller than me) ak 'the' + xaleyi (He is the best). Def ko 'more' '-er', ak 'most' '-est'.

title: Reflexive Verbs / Verbos wuññi
bridge: Ci español, yegg naa verbos wuññi ngir yegg (me levanto, me baño), bokk ci angale, ñi ko woon a ngi ci bokk. Tekki ci angale, li ko woon, ñaata lañu ngi ci yegg (I get up, I shower). Ci angale, pronoms wuññi (myself, yourself, etc.) ñoo ngi ko woon ci yegg, waaye ñaata lañu ngi ci yegg, te buñu ngi ci woon. Nga def lu tolloo ci yegg 'me' 'me' ci angale, waaye 'me' mooy këru, du ca wuññi.
rule: Ci angale, verbos wuññi yépp, ngir verb + pronom wuññi (myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves). Ñoo ngi ko woon ci yegg, ngir yegg ngir yegg. Waaye, ci yegg, verbos wuññi ci español, ñoo ngi ko woon pronom wuññi ci angale: get up, wake up, shave, shower, dress, feel, etc. Misaal: I get up at seven (du ca 'I get myself up'). I feel happy (du ca 'I feel myself happy'). Pronoms wuññi ñoo ngi ko woon ci yegg, ngir yegg: I did it myself. Ngir nivel A2, yegg ngir yegg: verbos wuññi ci yegg (get up, wash, dress) ak yégg ngir yegg ngir yegg: 'enjoy oneself' 'behave oneself'. Nga def lu tolloo 'myself' du ca yegg, ci angale, yegg 'I'.

title: Object Pronouns / Pronoom bu nekk
bridge: Ŋi àddiya, pronoom bu nekk (me, te, lo/la, le, nos, os, les) suñu feeñeer ndax verbu jàpp, waaye ŋi angiils, object pronouns (me, you, him, her, it, us, them) feeñu verbu ci kaw, walla feeñu preposisyon ci kaw. Ndax kat ŋi àddiya, a ngi defar lo/la ak le bu nekk bu njëkk, waaye ŋi angiils, him/her/them a ngi defar bu njëkk bu nekk, ndax bu njëkk bu njëkk, bu ko defee 'to' walla 'for'. Téggoo: ŋi angiils, ngiy def ko pronoom bu nekk, ndax ngiy waxe ko feeñeer, walla ngiy def ko 'lo' 'it' bu nekk bu njëkk.
rule: Pronoom bu nekk ŋi angiils, me, you, him, her, it, us, them. Bu ngi defar bu njabooti bu nekk bu njëkk (bu njëkk bu def ko), bu ko defar bu njëkk bu njëkk (bu njëkk bu def ko bu njëkk). Feeñu verbu ci kaw (I see him), walla feeñu preposisyon ci kaw (She gives it to me). Bu njëkk bu defar bu njëkk bu njëkk, bu ko defee 'verb + object + preposition' (She gave the book to him), walla 'verb + preposition + object' (She gave him the book). Àddiya, bu ko defee pronoom bu nekk bu njëkk bu defar 'le' ak 'lo', bu ko defar bu njëkk bu defar him walla her, bu ko defar 'ello' it.

title: Frequency Adverbs / Adverbiiy frekuensi
bridge: Wolof, adverbiiy frekuensi bopp ngir nag ñu jàng 'kontar' walla 'def', ñu xam ne 'siempre' walla 'nunca' suñu bëgg a ngi bokk ci verbe ('Siempre como fruta'), waaye wënë ngi bokk ci wàll, adverbiiy frekuensi ngi bokk ci ngi bokk ci verbe principal ('I always eat fruit') waaye ci digg ci verbe 'to be' ('I am always happy'). Naka noonu, wolof, ñu ngi cee 'nunca' te doble negation, waaye wënë ngi bokk ci wàll, 'never' a ngi bokk ci positif, duma ko 'don't'.
rule: Adverbiiy frekuensi wënë ngi bokk ci wàll (always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never) ngi jàng ci njëkk ñu jàng ci verbe. Ñu xam ne: 1) Ci ngi bokk ci verbe principal: 'She often reads.' 2) Ci digg ci verbe 'to be' (am/is/are): 'He is always late.' 3) Ci ngi bokk ci auxiliar ak verbe ci preguntas ak negations: 'Do you usually drink coffee?' 'I don't often go out.' Excepciones: 'sometimes' ak 'usually' ngi bokk ci ngi bokk ci oración bu njëkk ak bu ñaata la, ngir jàng ci njëkk: 'Sometimes I walk to work' / 'I walk to work sometimes'. 'Never', 'rarely' ak 'seldom' ngi bokk ci negatif, waaye ñu ngi bokk ci wàll 'not'. Ci 'never', verbe ngi bokk ci afirmatif: 'I never smoke' (duma ko 'I don't never smoke'). Ci respuestas cortas, ñu xam ne ci ngi bokk ci auxiliar: 'Yes, I usually do'.

title: Prepositions of Time / Wàllug Time
bridge: Ci angale, wàllug time (at, in, on) ñi ko jëfandikoo ci ñaari làkk, te bu ñu xool ci Spanyol. Baat baat la ne : 'on Monday' (dëmmël), 'in the morning' (suba), waññi 'at night' (nakk). Spanyol yi dafay wàll 'en' 'a' ngir jël ñaari làkk, ngir xool ci angale, wàllug time yi amul ci ñaari làkk : saa (at), dëmmël (on), wér (in).
rule: Ci angale, wàllug time mukk ñi : 'at' ngir saa yi ñu jëfandikoo, 'on' ngir dëmmël, 'in' ngir wér. Mëgg ci wàll ngir 'today', 'yesterday', 'tomorrow', 'this', 'that', 'every'. 'At' amul ngir wàll ci 'Christmas' waññi 'on Christmas day'.

title: Conjunctions: and, but, or, because, when, if / Jëfandikoo: y, pero, o, porque, cuando, si
bridge: Àddina, jëfandikoo yi ñi ngi ciy waxe woon, waaye ñoñ jëfandikoo woon. Baumu 'but' dees di ko jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo, ndax 'but' moom la ñi ngi ko jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo, waaye àddina 'but' dees nañu ko jëfandikoo ca komma ngir jëfandikoo mbiri oraciones, waaye àddina 'pero' dees di ko jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo ca komma. Jëfandikoo 'because' ak 'when' dees di ko jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo ca komma ngir jëfandikoo ca oración, ndax àddina 'because' ak 'when' dees di ko jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo ca komma ngir jëfandikoo ca oración.
rule:
Jëfandikoo yi ñi ngi ciy waxe woon ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo. Jëfandikoo yi ñi ngi ciy waxe woon: 
- 'and' (y) ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo.
- 'but' (pero) ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo.
- 'or' (o) ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo.
- 'because' (porque) ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo.
- 'when' (cuando) ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo.
- 'if' (si) ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo.

Àddina, jëfandikoo yi ñi ngi ciy waxe woon ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo, komma dees di ko jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo mbiri oraciones. Waaye àddina, jëfandikoo yi ñi ngi ciy waxe woon ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo, komma dees nañu ko jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo.

Jëfandikoo yi ñi ngi ciy waxe woon: 
- 'Because' ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo. 'Because' dees di ko jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo, waaye àddina 'because' dees nañu ko jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo.
- 'When' ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo. 'When' dees di ko jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo, waaye àddina 'when' dees nañu ko jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo.
- 'If' ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo. 'If' dees di ko jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo, waaye àddina 'if' dees nañu ko jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikoo.

title: Present Perfect Basics / Wàkku wu nekk
bridge: Àddina angale, ñu ngi ci yàkkaare (he comido) ñi ngi defaroon ci yèneen yi ak jàmm, waaye àddina angale, present perfect (I have eaten) moom lañuy defaroon, waaye ñu ngi defaroon it ñi ngi defar ci yèneen yi ak jàmm, te ñu ngi defaroon it ci yàkkaare (comí). Bokk nañu nekk, àddina angale, present perfect moom ngi defaroon it ci adyabaay yu bëgg yu nekk yu àdduna, te ñu ngi defaroon it ci yàkkaare; ñu ngi defaroon it ci adyabaay yu bëgg yu nekk yu àdduna, ngir ñu defaroon it ci yàkkaare.
rule: Present perfect moom ngi defaroon ci auxiliaire HAVE (have/has) + participium passé du verbe. Ngir verb yu régulier, participium moom taxaw ci passé simple (terminaison -ed: work -> worked). Ngir verb yu irrégulier, ngi defaroon it ci participium (go -> gone, see -> seen). Ñu ngi defaroon it: 1) Ngir defaroon ci yèneen yi ak jàmm te ñu defaroon it ci yàkkaare (e.g., I have visited Paris). 2) Ngir defaroon ci yèneen yi ak jàmm te ñu defaroon it ci yàkkaare (e.g., I have lost my keys). 3) Ngir defaroon it ci adyabaay yu bëgg yu nekk yu àdduna 'already' (ya), 'just' (akà), 'yet' (tòdd) ci pregunta yi ak negation yi. 4) Ngir defaroon it ci 'for' ak 'since' ngir defaroon ci yèneen yi ak jàmm (e.g., I have lived here for 10 years). Ci pregunta yi, ñu ngi defaroon it ci auxiliaire ci làkk: Have you finished? Ci negation yi: I have not (haven't) finished. Ñu ngi defaroon it ci adyabaay yu bëgg yu nekk yu àdduna 'yesterday', 'last week' etc., ngir ñu defaroon it ci yàkkaare, dàkkantale ko, present perfect.

title: Imperatives (Affirmative and Negative) / Imperatiif (affirmatif ak négatif)
bridge: En espagnol, l'imperatif a des formes différentes pour tu, vous, nous, vous, etc. En anglais, l'imperatif est beaucoup plus simple : il utilise toujours la forme de base du verbe, quelle que soit la personne à laquelle vous vous adressez. Par exemple, 'parle' (tu) et 'parlez' (vous) en anglais sont simplement 'speak'. De plus, pour nier, en anglais, on utilise 'don't' + verbe, tandis qu'en espagnol, on utilise 'no' + imperatif. Attention : on n'utilise pas 'doesn't' avec les pronoms ; on utilise 'don't' pour tous.
rule: L'imperatif en anglais se forme avec le verbe à sa forme de base (infinitif sans 'to'). Il est utilisé pour donner des ordres, des instructions, des conseils ou des suggestions. Exemples : 'Open the door', 'Listen to me'. Pour l'imperatif négatif, on place 'don't' (ou 'do not' en formal) avant le verbe de base : 'Don't open the door', 'Don't worry'. Il n'y a pas de différence entre singulier et pluriel ni entre formel et informel. On peut également utiliser 'let's' + verbe pour des suggestions (par exemple, 'Let's go'). En anglais, contrairement à l'espagnol, on n'utilise pas l'imperatif pour exprimer des désirs (comme 'que tu te rétablisses'), pour cela, on utilise d'autres structures.

title: Count and Uncount Nouns / Sustantivi kontabul ak inkontabul
bridge: Àdaxu Angale, wàkk-wàkk kontabul ak inkontabul man àgg na, waaye moom la guy feeñ. Feeñal, ñu ngi def 'panes' wëram konte piis bu pan, waaye àngale 'bread' inkontabul la, def ko wone seen plural. Biddewu fi, kontabul inkontabul àngale def ko wone 'a/an' walla 'one', waaye àdaxu ngir def wone 'a/an' biddewu, feeñal 'una información' àngale 'some information'
rule: Àngale, kontabul (count nouns) def ànd ak seen plural, def ko wone konte (one apple, two apples). Inkontabul (uncount nouns) def ko wone seen plural, def ko wone konte (water, rice, information). Konte inkontabul, ñu ngi def 'some', 'any', 'much', walla wàkk-wàkk bu 'a glass of' walla 'a piece of'. Kontabul, ñu ngi def 'a/an' seen singular, 'many' seen plural, 'few' pico. Inkontabul, ñu ngi def 'much' ak 'little'. Wàkk-wàkk def 'the' wone, waaye wàkk-wàkk bu def wone 'a/an' kontabul. Feeñal, kontabul inkontabul def wone seen konteksi (e.g., 'chicken' kontabul walla inkontabul)

title: Some and Any / Some ak Any (ak ñoñ compuesto)
bridge: Ñuñul español, ñu bëgg lu ñu man a 'jëggale', 'jëggal' ak 'dëgg' luñuy dàkkaral, luñuy defaral ak luñuy yékkatal. Ñu ngiisaanul angale, defaral 'some' ak 'any' dëggaral ngi ci làkk, ak ci làkkul ngirum xam-xam. Jëf jooju, ñu ñaari ñi ngi def 'some' ci yékkatal ak 'any' ci defaral ngir ñuñuy dëkkal español, waaye ngiisaanul, làkk bi dëgg la. Ñatt, 'any' ci defaral dëggaral làkkal 'jëggal'.
rule: Ñu ngi def 'some' (ak ñoñ compuesto: somebody, someone, something, somewhere) ci defaral ak ci yékkatal ñu defar ci làkk, walla ñu yegg ci làkk ngirum xam-xam, walla ñu dàkkaral ngirum xam-xam. Ñu ngi def 'any' (ak ñoñ compuesto: anybody, anyone, anything, anywhere) ci dëggal, ci yékkatal yépp, ak ci defaral dëggaral làkkal 'jëggal' ak 'dëggar'. Ñoñ compuesto dëgg nañu làkk: something/anything, somebody/anybody, someone/anyone, somewhere/anywhere. Ci ayi-bëgg, ñu ngi def 'some' ci juriñ, 'any' ci juriñ; ci ayi-dëgg, ñu ngi def 'some' ak 'any' ngir làkk. Ñu dëgg 'no' ci 'any' ci làkkal; ñu ngi def 'no' + ay, walla 'not... any'.

title: Much, Many, A lot of / Kuñu gu bari
bridge: Ñu ngi ci Spanyol, ñu def ngi 'mucho' walla 'muchos' ngir yonnee género ak numeer, ba ñu ngi Fransé, moomu def ngi ngone ci ku bari walla ku bari buñu, bu leesee género. Lii mooy def ngi jëfandikoo woon, waaye mooy jëfandikoo meloka: 'many' ngir yonnee bari ci ku bari, 'much' ngir yonnee bari buñu, 'a lot of' ngir yenn ci ñaar.
rule: Ñu ngi Fransé, kuñu gu bari 'much', 'many' ak 'a lot of' def ngi jëfandikoo ngir def ku bari. 'Many' def ngi jëfandikoo ngir kuñu gu bari ci ku bari (livres, woto, sériñ). 'Much' def ngi jëfandikoo ngir kuñu gu bari buñu (ndox, way, pexe). Ñu ngi def ngi 'a lot of' (walla 'lots of' ngir defaroon) ngir ñaar kuñu gu bari. Ñu ngi def ngi 'much' ak 'many' ngir defaroon. Ngir 'how much', ñu ngi def ngi jëfandikoo ngir def ku bari buñu (How much water?), ngir 'how many' ngir def ku bari (How many books?). 'Much' ak 'many' du def ngi jëfandikoo ngir kuñu gu bari buñu. Def ngi jëfandikoo ngir defaroon ngir 'too much', 'too many', 'so much', 'so many'. Ñu ngi def ngi 'much' ngir defaroon, mooy def ngi jëfandikoo ngir defaroon (There is much work). Ngir A2, mooy def ngi jëfandikoo ngir defaroon ngir def ngi 'a lot of' ngir defaroon, ngir def ngi 'much' ak 'many' ngir defaroon.

title: Relative Clauses: who, which, that / Jëfandikukat: who, which, that
bridge: Àdduna, ñu ngi ci waxoon ci yërëm, te ñu ngi ci waxoon ci yékk, te bu ñu ngi def ko ci ñaari yépp. Ci angale, ñu xam ne ñu amul 'who' (yërëm) ak 'which' (yékk), waaye 'that' ñu amul ko ci ñaari ñepp, ndax kat ci seeni yépp. Muy def, ci angale, pronoom relativel la ñu ko dégg, te ñu ko wax, te kat ci suuf si ko def mooy sujet, waaye ci spañol, ñu ko wax, te ñu ko dégg. Ci anam gu angale, ñu ngi def ko ci 'what' (lo que), waaye 'that' ak 'which' mooy ñi ngi def.
rule:
Jëfandikukat yi di jëfandikoo xool ci yërëm, yékk, walla jëfandikoo xool ci yërëm ak yékk. Ci angale, ñu ngi amul:

- **who** ci yërëm (sujet walla objekt), te kat ci làkk, ñu ngi ko amul ci yékk yu bari.
- **which** ci yékk, yékk yu bari, walla jëfandikoo.
- **that** ñu ngi amul ko ci yërëm ak yékk, ndax kat ci jëfandikukat yu amul.

Jëfandiku bu bees bu njëkk mooy: [jëme] + [pronom relativel] + [jëfandikukat].

Jëfandikoo:
- The man **who** lives next door is a doctor. (Yërëm bu ñu la juge ci kaw suuf mooy doktoor.)
- The book **which** I bought is interesting. (Jëme bu ñu tàmbli mooy jëme bu amul.)
- The dog **that** barks a lot is mine. (Jëkk bu ñu jàpp mooy jëkkam.)

**Jëfandikoo yu ndaw**:
- Ñu def ko ci 'what' ci jëfandikukat, waaye ci spañol 'qué' mooy jëme, waaye ci angale 'what' mooy lo que, te kat ñu ko amul ci jëfandikukat.
- Ñu def ko ci 'who/which/that' ci sujet, waaye kat ci angale, verbe bu bees bu njëkk mooy sujet.
- Kat ci angale, jëfandiku bu bees bu njëkk mooy sujet + verbe, waaye kat ci spañol, jëfandiku bu bees bu njëkk mooy verbe + sujet (sàkkoo: 'El hombre que vive aquí' -> 'The man who lives here', waaye def na 'The man who here lives').

**Jëfandikoo yu jëme**: Def na kow, 'that' mooy jëme ci yërëm ak yékk. 'Who' mooy jëme ci yërëm, waaye 'which' mooy jëme ci yékk. Ci angale bu njëkk, 'that' mooy jëme, waaye 'who' ak 'which' mooy jëme yu jëme.
